t: How AI Code Assistance Accidentally Tanked My SEO Traffic
s: Using AI code assistance to optimize Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) inadvertently made website content invisible to search engine crawlers due to incorrect handling of `visibility: hidden`, causing a significant SEO traffic drop. The issue was resolved by prioritizing content visibility over CLS prevention.
